scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/providers && npm run build --workspace packages/storage && npm run build --workspace packages/deployment && npx prisma generate --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/worker && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/providers && node --test packages/providers/dist/**/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/providers && npm run build --workspace packages/storage && npm run build --workspace packages/deployment && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/database && npx prisma generate --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
